title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 087
review_goal: Differentiate soup pot and sparkles variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Cooking pot body with one spoon inside and two steam curls rising above the rim
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the pot to read as active cooking with a spoon and steam visible.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the lidded pot when the cookware should look closed with side handles and no spoon inside.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot includes the spoon and steam which make it distinct from the simpler lidded pot variant.

items.depicts_observation: Cooking pot with a fitted lid and two side handles around a wide rounded body
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a closed pot silhouette without the spoon and steam of active stirring.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the stirred soup pot when the cookware should not show a spoon rising from the open bowl.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot closes the pot with a lid and side handles instead of showing steam and a spoon.

items.depicts_observation: One large diamond star with one smaller diamond star at the lower left
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants sparkles to read as a large diamond star paired with one smaller companion star.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the sparkle variants with an extra dot accent or with a full ring of short rays around the center.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the clean two star pairing without the extra dot accent or the sunburst ray ring.

items.depicts_observation: One large diamond star with one small diamond star and one small dot at the upper left
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the sparkle group to include one extra dot accent beside the large and small stars.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain two star sparkle or the central star with short rays around it.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds the extra dot accent that does not appear in the plain two star sparkle variant.

items.depicts_observation: Diamond star centered inside eight short rays around the outer rim
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the sparkle to feel radiant with a full ring of short rays around the center star.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the simpler sparkle pairs when the mark should not reduce to only two stars or two stars plus one dot.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot surrounds the center star with many short rays instead of using only a small companion sparkle.
